input.rationale:
Provisional stop at the completed local response-validity endpoint. The current research index marks both units checked, with no remaining obligations or open review issues. No accepted artifact needs construction, execution repair, checker correction or correspondence review.

Retained results: (1) source review explained direct cross-leader-incarnation support contamination through fresh commitment/channel allocation and captured worker references (candidate a12b3504351b401ea81a7af450359eaf); (2) trusted direct execution 183d31024372490eaa400890d8fa2127 observed one Response call on an actual failed in-memory timeout future, and review of artifact 8e175c8096984a60923b5cce5ff76c89 attributed that local interface-use discrepancy; (3) trusted direct execution a937a5b3c07b4272b8d9f05c0b4faca9 observed an actual network decode failure with EOF and partial Success=true promoting peer match from 0 to 2 for prefix-68. Empty-input control retained match 0, and intact prefix-69 advanced match to 2 with no error. Review of artifact d06a50c84a414f0fbe4d3e5fd85b6496 found correspondence within the declared local interface-acceptance scope. All observed commit indexes were 0. The preceding prefix exploration is retained as research guidance, not formal property Evidence.

Why no further check is selected for this relation: the successful full response used by the truncation fixture was scripted, so these observations cannot discriminate whether promoted support is physically false. The next source review found that the actual new-suffix follower branch calls StoreLogs synchronously, returns with Success=false on its error, and assigns Success=true only after successful return; the network handler uses a per-request reply channel (candidate e62e91d3e2c343b4add2fd684532c3a2). Merely adding a local quorum to the same fixture, rerunning truncation boundaries, or assuming absent stored support in a model would not resolve that causal gap. No new same-history false-support producer or invalidation relation has been established to justify extending this bounded question to an unsafe decision. A different fault/history question would need its own grounded premises rather than relabeling these results.

Precise remaining gaps: no actual follower storage execution is correlated with the failed network response and match update; no deployment-selected persistent store or crash durability is established; duplicate-only processing, snapshot restore, stale retained metadata, later log invalidation and restart histories are unexamined; full elected-leader replication scheduling, quorum consequences, application effects and client completion are not executed. In-repository store implementations are not externalized by constructor injection. The checked discrepancies are interface-level results, not a finding of false durable support or consensus-safety failure. The source explanations do not retract either checked result or prove broader correctness. The descriptive inventory remains partial, with no full responsibility or configuration coverage claimed.

result.summary: Provisional stop: both local interface discrepancies are checked and reviewed, with no open issues. Failed network decoding advanced peer match, but false durability and unsafe commitment remain unestablished. Precise remaining gaps are recorded.
